_README: Studio Fingers world registry — the FALLBACK, not the interface. A build should declare its own world with <meta name='tsp:world'> and <meta name='tsp:touches'>; self-describing HTML keeps the fact in one place. This file exists for one reason: GitHub's Contents API refuses to return files over ~1MB, so the connector write lane is blind on the studio's largest builds and cannot add a meta tag to them. Precedence: CLI flags > the build's own meta > this file. Every sidecar resolution prints a note in the agent's card, so a world resolved from here is never silent. Delete an entry the day its build can declare itself.

choose-your-leader-v7.html.note: 1,586,332 B — above the connector ceiling. Verified 2026-08-26: eight inert touches (television, evening paper, telephone, doorway, bulletin, wall map). Applier for the in-file meta lives at patches/2026-08-26-cyl-v7-declares-its-world.patch.
